chain_words.nuance: moving on foot slowly and calmly
moving on foot at a normal pace
moving on foot at a steady, light running pace
running at full speed for a short distance

explanation: These words all describe moving on foot, from a slow, relaxed pace to running at full speed.

usage_notes.difference: 'Walk' means moving on foot at a normal pace with at least one foot on the ground; 'run' is faster and has a moment when both feet leave the ground.
